summary: MicroVision, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus to register up to 61,315,970 shares of common stock for resale by High Trail Special Situations LLC and High Trail Special Situations II LLC. The shares are issuable upon conversion of senior secured convertible notes due 2028, issued in a private placement on February 23, 2026. MicroVision receives no proceeds from this resale registration. The filing is a routine shelf takedown for secondary sales by selling stockholders, not a special situation. The stock closed at $0.63 per share on April 23, 2026. No event-driven catalyst or transactional structure beyond standard resale mechanics is present.
